messages.content: "請問你能幫我訂製一尊20英吋大的大理石馬雕塑，接著再訂製一尊15英吋大的木製狗雕塑，然後是一幅以紅色為主色調的30英吋大的日落畫作，最後再訂製一幅以藍色為主色調的25英吋大的城市風景畫嗎？"

function.name: sculpture_create_custom
function.description: Order a custom sculpture with your preferred material. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

item.description: The subject of the sculpture, e.g. horse

size.description: The desired size for the sculpture in inches. This parameter is optional. Default is 10 inches if not specified.

function.name: painting_create_custom
function.description: Order a custom painting with your preferred color. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

subject.description: The subject of the painting, e.g. horse

color.description: Preferred main color for the painting.

size.description: The desired size for the painting in inches. This parameter is optional. Default is 20 inches if not specified.

message.reasoning:
The user wants:

1) A 20-inch marble horse sculpture.

2) A 15-inch wood dog sculpture.

3) A red-themed 30-inch sunset painting.

4) A blue-themed 25-inch cityscape painting.

We need to call two different functions: sculpture_create_custom and painting_create_custom twice each? Actually we have one function per type; but we can call multiple times.

But note: For sculptures, item field expects something like "horse". Material options include Bronze, Marble, Terracotta, Wood, Stone. So first request: item="horse", material=Marble, size=20.

Second: item="dog", material=Wood, size=15.

For paintings: subject param name is "subject": maybe "sunset"? But they want an image of a sunset. They say "a painting with red as primary color." Subject could be "Sunset". Size=30.

Fourth: subject "Cityscape" or "Urban landscape". Color Blue. Size=25.

Thus we will produce calls accordingly.

We'll output JSON calls using tool invocation format. We'll do four separate calls. Probably best to combine them into array? Usually you just provide sequential calls. Let's give them all.

Also ensure correct naming: In function signature, it's painting_create_custom(subject:string,color:"...").

So let's create calls.

First sculpture: {item:"Horse", material:"Marble", size:20}

Second sculpture: {item:"Dog", material:"Wood", size:15}

Third painting: {subject:"Sunset", color:"Red", size:30}

Fourth painting: {subject:"Cityscape", color:"Blue", size:25}

Return those calls.
